title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin closes the US session at sixty-four thousand seven hundred twenty-eight dollars, up a slim two-tenths of a percent while fear and greed sits at twenty-five in extreme fear territory. Hashrate holds firm at eight hundred fifty-two exahashes, showing miners are not backing down. The mempool is jammed with over one hundred five thousand transactions, yet fees remain cheap at three satoshis. Key takeaway: price stability masks heavy congestion and weak sentiment.
